notes: University layer: there is intentionally no campuswide policy on student AI use; the Senate CEP syllabus guidelines require an AI policy in every syllabus at instructor discretion, and DTEI pages restate this. The DTEI example-statements Google Doc was fetched through fetch_text's Google Docs export route. Excluded: OVPTL 'ChatGPT FAQs 6 Months In' (2023 message aimed at writing instructors; https://ovptl.uci.edu/news/chatgpt-faqs-6-months-in-a-campuswide-message-from-ovptl-and-the-campus-writing-communication-coordinator/, file v2-uc-irvine-ovptl-faq); OAISC faculty page (https://conduct.uci.edu/academic-integrity-info-for-faculty-staff/, file v2-uc-irvine-oaisc), whose only AI text is optional sample language for writing classes; DTEI hub and assessment pages (links only). School/computing: the Bren School of ICS is the combined school-and-computing unit (departments of Computer Science, Informatics, Statistics); no ICS-, department-, or Samueli School/EECS-level AI policy found. Course layer: both courses are by the same instructor (Thornton), whose pages are the only public Fall 2026 ICS syllabi found. CS 175 syllabus (uc-irvine-cs175.github.io) checked: no AI policy. Informatics, Statistics/data science, and EECS course syllabi appear to sit in Canvas; none public found.
